description: Windsor.ai is a marketing and business data integration platform that connects hundreds of advertising, analytics, CRM, e-commerce, and warehouse sources to BI tools, databases, spreadsheets, and AI assistants. It standardizes and syncs that data so users can query, analyze, and in some cases take write actions from connected tools.
summary: Windsor.ai exposes two developer integration surfaces on its own domains: a query-parameter-authenticated REST API at `connectors.windsor.ai` and an OAuth-capable hosted MCP server at `mcp.windsor.ai` that also accepts a Windsor API key as a Bearer token fallback.
